## What's new

**Guard commands run by themselves after 10 seconds**
- When your guard mutes, deafens or disconnects you, you get a notice with a 10 second countdown, **Allow now** and **Refuse**. If you don't press anything, the command runs by itself when the countdown ends.
- **Refuse** (or **Block**) stops it. After it runs you can still **Undo**.
- If you'd rather have commands apply instantly, turn on *Personal Guards: apply your guardians' commands right away* in the plugin settings.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord, or the installer at https://friendsinvoice.sarhsoft.com. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.23.0.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
